items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: The interviewee confirms the identity of Louie Tio ('That's a perfect picture of him') and acknowledges the interviewer's statement that Tio 'used to play with Armstrong', but the interviewee does not describe any personal interaction or relationship with Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: Yeah, I just found out, I think that his brother is an uncle. They live on London there. Louie.
That's it. Well, no, I want to know where he's living. Oh, Louie. Louie. Louie. Louie.
Louie. His name is Louie. His last name is Tio then too. Louie Tio.
